title: Not the Turkey: What 4,000 Calories Does to You 🦃 #shorts
description:
Max eats a 4,000-calorie holiday feast and we follow it inside: a stomach that stretches like a balloon, a "full" signal that arrives 20 minutes late, and a blood-sugar crash.
Spoiler: turkey has less tryptophan than cheese, so the food coma is really about the calories.

Who falls asleep first after the big dinner in your family? 👇

Follow @BodyQuest3D.official for a new body fact every day
